situation.line: Activity was recorded in the 12 hours to 12:00 on 20 Sept, across six incidents. The weight was spread across five fronts — Western Taiz and Al-Wazi'iyah; Red Sea coast; Marib among them — comprising three ground engagements and three reported strikes.

fronts.name: Bab al-Mandab and the south-west coast
fronts.line: The strait and the high ground above it carry the shipping lane between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden. Nothing was reported from this front in the 12 hours to 12:00 on 20 Sept.

fronts.name: Red Sea coast
fronts.line: The Red Sea coast controls access to Hodeidah, the main import route for the north. In the 12 hours to 12:00 on 20 Sept the desk logged one reported strike.

fronts.name: Western Taiz and Al-Wazi'iyah
fronts.line: Western Taiz is the hinge between the coast and the highlands, and the approach to Taiz city. In the 12 hours to 12:00 on 20 Sept the desk logged two ground engagements and two reported strikes.

fronts.name: Marib
fronts.line: Marib holds Yemen's main oil and gas infrastructure and the government's northern stronghold. In the 12 hours to 12:00 on 20 Sept the desk logged one reported strike.

fronts.name: Al-Dhale and Lahj
fronts.line: Al-Dhale and Lahj sit astride the roads north from Aden. In the 12 hours to 12:00 on 20 Sept the desk logged one ground engagement.

fronts.name: Al-Jawf
fronts.line: Al-Jawf is the northern desert flank, linking Marib to the Saudi border. In the 12 hours to 12:00 on 20 Sept the desk logged one reported strike.

fronts.name: The Saudi home front
fronts.line: The Saudi home front is where long-range fire and air defence alerts register inside the kingdom. Nothing was reported from this front in the 12 hours to 12:00 on 20 Sept.

fronts.name: Energy and shipping
fronts.line: Energy and shipping is where the fighting reaches oil exports and the Red Sea corridor. Nothing was reported from this front in the 12 hours to 12:00 on 20 Sept.

numbers.line: Logged by this desk in the 12 hours to 12:00 on 20 Sept: three ground engagements and three reported strikes.
